name: StoreKit 2 subscriptions and paywall
description: Load subscription products, purchase, restore and track entitlements with StoreKit 2, a paywall view, and a local StoreKit configuration for simulator testing.

cost.note: Apple keeps a commission on digital sales; selling requires an Apple Developer Program membership and paid-apps agreement

amounts.label: Apple Developer Program membership (needed to distribute; not needed for simulator builds)

usage: Create `StoreModel(productIDs: StoreProducts.all, service: StoreKitPurchaseService())` at the composition root. Present `PaywallView(model:features:)` (features is a list of short strings). Gate premium features on `model.isPremium`. Attach `.task { await model.load() }` and `.task { await model.listenForTransactions() }` once near the root. Digital goods must use StoreKit, never Apple Pay or Stripe.
statusNote: Not yet built on a Mac; run `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify storekit2-paywall` on a Mac with Xcode.
